text: rachel-design: Quick design pass on the retention modal — region picker + retention dropdown + encryption badge. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ghi (screens attached). Need copy that doesn’t imply we hold keys, keyboard/a11y for badge, and human CSV headers. mike-eng: We default to the org-configured region. If org has no default show a small 'Fallback: Global' line. Persist user overrides separately so we don't auto-change on locale. zara-copy: Microcopy options (short): A) "Retention period 10 days (storage region: eu-west-1)" B) "Data retained for 10 days. Storage region: eu-west-1." I prefer A for compactness. ian-a11y: A11y nits: the encryption badge must be keyboard-focusable and readable by screen readers. Don’t use role=img. Provide a short accessible name and an aria-describedby pointing to an sr-only description. Keyboard order: region -> retention -> encryption badge -> help. maria-legal: Legal check: avoid wording that implies custody. Use "managed by your KMS" or "under your KMS policy". No ARNs or key IDs in tooltips/examples. omar-pm: CSV export: map region_id -> "Storage region" and policy_id -> "Retention policy". Add "Encryption" column with values like "Platform-managed" or "Customer-managed (KMS region: eu-west-1)" so ops can filter. mike-eng: Implementation snippet for CSV header mapping: ``` const headers = { region_id: 'Storage region', policy_id: 'Retention policy' } // encryption values mapped to human text server-side ``` zara-copy: On-screen badge copy: short labels only: "Customer-managed" / "Platform-managed". Tooltip (longer): "Customer-managed encryption key (managed by your KMS, region: eu-west-1)." Maria ok with that? maria-legal: That phrasing is fine, please use "encryption key" and avoid implying Redwood custody. ian-a11y: Suggested markup (avoid role=img): ``` Customer-managed Encryption type Customer-managed encryption key, managed by your KMS, region: eu-west-1 ``` Ensure visible focus ring and contrast. rachel-design: Thanks — I'll update the Figma with copy A, add the fallback text and the sr-only nodes, and annotate the CSV header change in the spec. Will ping this thread when the PR is up for a quick pass. :wave: ci-bot: Staging build 2026-04-01T13:05:00 deployed: https://staging.redwood.ai/console/retention (accessibility snapshot attached).
